$comment: Every compiler setting ploaness owns, with nothing that assumes a framework. The sibling tsconfig.json adds the Next language-service plugin and nothing else, so a member with no Next application inherits the identical strictness rather than a second copy of it that could drift.
$comment-types: A member extending this one runs on node and nothing else - ploaness requires node 26 and ESM - so it is told so. Left unset, a tooling member could not compile `import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'`: automatic @types discovery does not reach the package under pnpm's layout, and a Next member never noticed because next-env.d.ts pulls the node types in behind it. ploaness declares exactly this in every one of its own package tsconfigs and did not ship it.
